answer: Reactor operators resist sybil attacks by binding each agent to a physically attested channel, forcing any adversary to forge hardware-rooted proof before entering the pool. At the nadir of reputational trust, a distributed ledger cross-checks every submission against independent sensor quorums, so fake identities cannot form an oasis of uncontested votes. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
